coaching: Clean comment — call type, priority, and the key facts are all present and consistent. What a comment like this has not been tested against yet is a caller who gives you the facts out of order and changes one of them halfway through. Run a difficult-caller scenario before you call this settled.
ballot.model_comments: Cold burglary at RP's residence on Halsted. Garage entered, window forced on RP's sedan; laptop and wallet taken from the back seat. Suspect(s) gone on arrival. RP has photos of the damage and wants a report for insurance.

proves: the score and the ballot are unaltered since the timestamp
does_not_prove: the sim was not attempted before
scope.method: sha256 digest of the canonical JSON ballot object (score, verdict, and whatever fields the grading engine produced), bound to a stated timestamp inside the receipt body; hash-chained in arcaeon-ledger, one row per ballot.
